Name: Better text editing & copy/paste
tl;dr: Notion’s text editor has been completely retooled to combine the flexibility of “blocks” with the familiar feeling of a traditional word processor.

Name: Template gallery launch
tl;dr: We rebuilt our Template Gallery from the ground up to showcase the very best dashboards, setups & workflows built by our users around the world.

Name: Database permissions launch
tl;dr: The new “Can Edit Content” permission level prevents accidental edits to the database’s structure — views, filters, property names, property types & more.

Name: Database groups
tl;dr: Group items by any property in your database views to achieve peak organization.

Name: Sub-page load time
tl;dr: Thanks to a few under-the-hood improvements, deeply nested sub-pages now load and save over 50% faster. 57%, to be exact!

Name: Better databases
tl;dr: Databases are easier to use, easier to customize, and more powerful than ever before.
